EC1: 1. Use of rituximab, [OR] belimumab, [OR] eculizumab [OR] or any monoclonal antibody for immunomodulation within 6 months prior to first dosing.
EC2: 2. Immunoglobulins [OR] given by SC, [OR] IV (IVIG), [OR] or intramuscular route, or plasmapheresis/plasma exchange (PE) within 4 weeks before Screening.
EC3: 3. Thymectomy performed < 12 months prior to screening.
EC6: Other, more specific exclusion criteria are defined in the protocol
